correctness.rationale: For finite thick partial geometries s,t>=2 in explicitly enriched signature with point and line sort predicates, incidence, named irreflexive collinearity and concurrence, the point/line parameters yield all ordered-pair third-vertex extension counts. Their support changes only when alpha equals u or u+1 for u=s,t; e.g. for a noncollinear point pair, the neither-neighbour third-point count equals (t-1)+(s-alpha)*(t*(s-alpha+1)-alpha)/alpha>0. The other candidate zero counts contain (s-alpha), (s+1-alpha) or line dual factors. Thus equal status pair (sigma(s,alpha),sigma(t,alpha)) gives identical realizable three-pebble atomic types; an indefinite back-and-forth strategy proves FO^3 equivalence for arbitrary quantifier depth, not just rank three. A rank-two sentence detects noncollinear pairs and a rank-three sentence detects collinear p,q with z adjacent to neither, separating sigma 0 vs 1 vs 2; dual line sentences give nine distinct theories. Nine explicit finite geometries (symplectic generalized quadrangle, affine net, transversal design, affine plane, Fano plane, PG(3,2) design and duals) realize each status. The supplied independent-incidence verifier was inspected; bounded finite examples are supportive rather than proof of unbounded equivalence.
